note: Per-theme instrument palettes for the music SUITES (ab-1, docs/AUDIOBOOK_V2_PLAN.md §4.5). A suite is generated ONCE per theme from these fixed words + the world-law card's palette line + the cue's fixed mood line; editing a palette changes the suite prompt hash and elects a new suite. Every suite is instrumental, gentle, no vocals, no heavy percussion.

global.style: gentle instrumental children's storybook score, warm and clear, no vocals, no lyrics, no heavy drums, no distortion, no sudden loud hits, a natural ending that resolves
global.negative: vocals, singing, lyrics, rap, heavy drums, electric guitar distortion, harsh synth, sirens, screams, dissonance, abrupt stop

theme_intro.mood: a bright, welcoming opening signature — the sound of arriving somewhere wonderful; a clear melody the whole suite shares

calm.mood: calm, unhurried, content — a quiet afternoon; the shared melody hinted softly

playful.mood: playful, bouncy, light on its feet — skipping and giggling; the shared melody at a hop

wonder.mood: hushed wonder and curiosity — something magical just came into view; the shared melody floating, slow

tender.mood: tender, close, loving — a hug at the end of the day; the shared melody, warm and simple

gentle_tension.mood: gentle, child-safe suspense — a tiptoe, a question mark, never scary; the shared melody in a minor colour, quiet

triumph.mood: proud and joyful — we did it together; the shared melody, fuller and brighter

lullaby_outro.mood: a lullaby ending — slowing down, softer and softer, the shared melody one last time, a gentle final chord that fades to rest

refrain_motif.mood: a tiny four-second sparkle of the shared melody — a musical wink that announces a repeated line; ends cleanly

farm.instruments: warm acoustic guitar, fiddle, soft upright piano, a light shaker

dinosaur.instruments: marimba, low bassoon, warm strings, soft hand drum
dinosaur.feel: wide prehistoric valley, big and friendly

space.instruments: soft synth pads, celesta, glass bells, a low gentle hum

under_the_sea.instruments: harp, glass marimba, slow pads, a soft vibraphone

jungle.instruments: kalimba, wooden flute, gentle hand percussion, warm nylon guitar

safari.instruments: kora, warm strings, soft djembe, a wooden flute
safari.feel: golden grass, big sky, gentle animals

enchanted_forest.instruments: celesta, harp, soft strings, a music box

pirate.instruments: accordion, tin whistle, nylon guitar, a soft frame drum
pirate.feel: salt breeze, a friendly ship, a treasure map

construction.instruments: bright xylophone, brushed drum kit played softly, tuba, clarinet
construction.feel: busy, cheerful, hard hats and big machines

dream.instruments: music box, soft pads, harp, a whispering choir of synth voices without words

christmas.instruments: sleigh bells, piano, warm strings, a soft celesta

thanksgiving.instruments: acoustic guitar, warm piano, cello, a soft brush snare
thanksgiving.feel: autumn leaves, a long table, gratitude

fallback.note: The CC0 freepd.com beds V1 shipped (data/audio/fallback/CREDITS.md) — the fail-open floor when a suite cue cannot be elected.
